title: Connect wallet successfully
steps: Open app; click Connect Wallet; approve in MetaMask
actual_result: Website displayed the connected account address after approval

title: Reject wallet connection
steps: Click Connect Wallet; reject the MetaMask request
expected_result: Website displays a clear rejection message

title: Switch wallet account
precondition: Wallet connected and multiple accounts available
steps: Switch from Account 1 to Account 2; observe website
expected_result: Website displays the currently selected account address
actual_result: Website address changed to match Account 2
